Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Matthew 2:20-23 opens with a scene marked by faithful response to God's word. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from faithful response instead of vague admiration. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue concrete obedience under the authority of the passage. Amen.
